title: Could not find type "GDScriptFunctionState" in the current scope.
body:
### Tested versions

Reproduced in 4.5.2 and 4.6.2

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.6.2.stable.steam.71f334935 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

The class `GDScriptFunctionState` is unknown to GdScript, this forced me to make a workaround in a particular case.
I was adapting some code from Godot 3.5 to 4.x
Original snippet:
```gdscript
if is_instance_valid(target):
	if target.has_method(method_name):
		var func_result = target.callv(method_name, args)
		
		if (func_result is GDScriptFunctionState):
			yield(func_result, "completed")
```
This code was calling a function without knowing if it was async or not, this would be the equivalent if class name was known:
```gdscript
if is_instance_valid(target):
	if target.has_method(method_name):
		var func_result = target.callv(method_name, args)
		
		if func_result is GDScriptFunctionState:
			await func_result.completed
```
but because GDScriptFunctionState is unknown i had to make a workaround:
```gdscript
if (typeof(func_result) == TYPE_OBJECT and func_result.get_class() == "GDScriptFunctionState"):
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run MRP script in an empty scene

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This script will fail to parse if swapping comments in lines 8 and 9
```gdscript
extends Node2D


# Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time.
func _ready() -> void:
	var state: Variant = callv(&"_do_something", [1, 2])
	print("state is ", typeof(state), " -> ", state.get_class())
	#if state is GdScriptFunctionState:
	if (typeof(state) == TYPE_OBJECT and state.get_class() == "GDScriptFunctionState"):
		state = await state
	print("state now is ", state)

func _do_something(a, b) -> int:
	await get_tree().create_timer(2).timeout
	print("a is ", a, " and b is ", b)
	return 4
```
